# mesh

Benchmarks of [`ordito.mesh`](../api/ordito/mesh.md) against every library that computes the same thing. Each chart shows the time of every library relative to ordito on CUDA (1x, in green): a longer bar took longer. The table under each chart lists every input the function was measured on. See [Benchmarks](index.md) for how to read and reproduce these numbers.

*Measured on GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 · CPU: Intel Xeon w7-2495X*

No other library computes these, so they have no comparison. ordito (CUDA)'s median time on the largest input it was measured on:

|---|---|---|

| `mesh_vector_heat_operators` | sphere_large warm=True | 4.1 µs |
| `mesh_invalidation` | lucy mode=with_faces | 17.22 ms |

| `mesh_from_warp_mesh` | sphere_small | 8.2 µs |
| `mesh_traced_mesh` | lucy warm=True | 2.5 µs |
| `mesh_mesh_for_rays` | lucy n_rays=1099511627776 | 3.858 s |
| `mesh_halfedge_mates` | lucy warm=True | 2.3 µs |
| `mesh_oriented_boundary_edges` | lucy warm=True | 2.8 µs |
| `mesh_boundary_vertex_indices` | lucy warm=True | 2.0 µs |
| `mesh_is_orientable` | lucy warm=True | 2.0 µs |
| `mesh_is_self_intersecting` | lucy warm=True | 2.4 µs |
